services.name: SceneResource_PrepareRenderFrame
services.behavior: Waits for VBlank, refreshes transition state, clears the transition VDP plane, and runs the shared VDP fill helpers.

services.name: SceneResource_RunServiceLoop
services.behavior: Runs up to 300 VBlank-paced iterations while scene-resource status is clear, ticking AnimationVM and MovementVM, building actor-only records, and submitting both sprite stages.

services.name: SceneResource_RunFadeAndReset
services.behavior: Runs the resource loop when needed, applies the palette transition, clears actor resources, and copies the prepared scene words to VRAM.

services.name: SceneResource_RunTransitionCommandStream
services.behavior: Consumes the transition stream passed by Scene_ResetToState0, running timed AnimationVM, VBlank, query, and sprite services; handles end, palette-band, and timed-stream commands before applying the final palette/VDP reset.

conclusion: The scene-resource lifecycle has an explicit VBlank service loop followed by palette fade, actor reset, and final VRAM copy, with render-frame preparation as a reusable inner stage.
